svg.title: MLA that reads only the selected positions
svg.desc: Add the indexer’s selection mask M to the absorbed MLA score S_h, the sum of content and rotary scores, then apply softmax. P_h is nonzero only at the selected positions per row and weights Cᴷⱽ into U_h.
svg.text: MLA that reads only the selected positions
Absorbed MLA scores + selection mask M · one head
